_note: Live rates for cost/time estimates. Every block has source + checked date. Re-check before a big decision. Third-party pages are marked (verify).

github_actions.billing: whole minutes per job, rounded up; included amount is money, not minutes ($12 = 2000 Linux 2-core min)

kaggle.note: weekly GPU quota is not published by Kaggle; ~30 h/week is user-reported and shows in account settings. Faiz's notebook showed 30 h.

gcp.note: VM price only; disk, network and idle time are extra. itcod-gpu stops itself after 10 idle min.

colab.free: limited T4, no published quota, 12 h max session

gemini.free_tier_note: limits lower than paid; free-tier content may be used by Google to improve products
gemini.alias_note: gemini-flash-latest (used in limits.models) = newest flash; priced here as gemini-3.8-flash. Flash 3.6/3.8 double on 2027-01-01 (in 1.50, out 7.50).
gemini.source: https://www.morphllm.com/gemini-api-pricing (third party, article checked Google's page 2026-10-25; verify on ai.google.dev)

claude.plan_now: Claude Pro (flat monthly; limits are usage, not tokens)
claude.note: API-equivalent only: on the Pro plan Faiz does not pay per token, he spends limit. Use it to compare plans.
